dialogue.elder.greeting: Ah, you arrive like a breeze over old hills.
dialogue.player.reply: Elder, I seek guidance in cultivation.
dialogue.choice.brash: I can manage on my own.
dialogue.elder.offer_help: Very well. Take this scroll and meditate on its words.
dialogue.elder.take_care: Then go forth and temper your heart as you temper the blade.
dialogue.blacksmith.hum: The hammer sings and the forge breathes.
dialogue.blacksmith.sigh: A well-tempered blade bears memory of its maker.
mono.farmer.work: (The farmer hums as he tends the fields.)
mono.child.laugh: (A child's laugh echoes through the lane.)
mono.temple.bells: (Temple bells toll softly in the morning mist.)
mono.old.poet: I have lived long enough to see the seasons fold into themselves.
mono.dao.shake_line1: My dao heart trembles — what have I done?
dialogue.dao_dilemma.save: Save them — my path will be tested.
dialogue.dao_dilemma.ignore: Let fate run its course; I cannot be burdened.
